msgid: Boosts the defenses of\nthose with Plus or Minus.
msgstr: Monte DF et DS du lanceur\net des alliés Plus ou Minus.

msgid: Boosts the attacks of\nthose with Plus or Minus.
msgstr: Monte AT et AS du lanceur\net des alliés Plus ou Minus.

msgid:
These bird Pokémon are excellent divers.
They are better at swimming than flying,
and they happily eat their favorite food,
peat moss, as they dive underwater.
msgstr:
Ces Pokémon oiseaux plongent à merveille.
Ils nagent mieux qu’ils ne volent et
dégustent sous l’eau leur mets favori: la
sphaigne.

msgid:
It's found crawling on beaches and
seafloors. The coral that grows on
Corsola's head is as good as a five-star
banquet to this Pokémon.
msgstr:
Il rampe le long des fonds marins et des
plages de sable. Les cornes de corail des
CORAYON sont ses biscuits apéritifs
préférés.
